reveal: Paris! The City of Light has been France's capital for over a thousand years!
Tokyo! The most populous metropolitan area on Earth and Japan's capital!
Canberra! Not Sydney! Australia's capital was purpose-built in nineteen thirteen as a compromise!
Ottawa! Not Toronto! Canada's capital sits right on the Ontario-Quebec border!
Washington D.C.! Not New York! The capital was purpose-built between Maryland and Virginia!
London! Home of Big Ben and Buckingham Palace, capital of the United Kingdom!
Berlin! Reunified as Germany's capital in nineteen ninety after the Wall came down!
Rome! The Eternal City, capital of Italy and once the heart of a mighty empire!
Madrid! Europe's highest capital city, sitting over six hundred metres above sea level!
Brasília! Not Rio! Brazil's futuristic capital was built from scratch in the nineteen fifties!
Beijing! Home of the Forbidden City, capital of the world's most populous country!
New Delhi! India's capital, planned and built by the British in the twentieth century!
Moscow! Home of the Kremlin and Red Square, capital of the world's largest country!
Mexico City! Built on the ruins of ancient Tenochtitlán, one of the world's great capitals!
Seoul! One of the world's most connected megacities and capital of South Korea!
Pretoria! Not Cape Town or Johannesburg! South Africa's executive capital in the north!
Cairo! The largest city in Africa and the Arab world, gateway to the Pyramids!
Buenos Aires! The Paris of South America and capital of Argentina!
Ankara! Not Istanbul! Turkey moved its capital to Ankara in nineteen twenty-three!
Abuja! Not Lagos! Nigeria's purpose-built capital has been the official capital since nineteen ninety-one!
Amsterdam! Officially the capital, though the Dutch government sits in The Hague!
Bern! Not Zurich or Geneva! Bern is Switzerland's federal city and de facto capital!
Wellington! Not Auckland! New Zealand's compact and notoriously windy capital!
Islamabad! Not Karachi or Lahore! Pakistan's planned capital was built in the nineteen sixties!
Astana! Not Almaty! Kazakhstan moved its capital to this futuristic city on the steppe!
Kuala Lumpur! City of the iconic Twin Towers and capital of Malaysia!
Bangkok! Its full ceremonial name is the longest official place name in the world!
Hanoi! Not Ho Chi Minh City! Vietnam's northern capital and seat of government!
Jakarta! The sinking capital of Indonesia, currently being replaced by a new city called Nusantara!
Riyadh! The desert capital at the heart of the world's largest oil exporter!
Tehran! Nestled at the foot of the Alborz Mountains, capital of Iran!
Jerusalem! A deeply contested capital, claimed by Israel but recognised by very few nations!
Kyiv! One of Eastern Europe's oldest cities and capital of Ukraine!
Stockholm! Built across fourteen islands where Lake Mälar meets the Baltic Sea!
Oslo! The Viking capital of Norway, surrounded by forests and fjords!
Bucharest! Once called the Little Paris of the East, now Romania's capital!
Vienna! Imperial capital of the old Habsburg Empire and city of Mozart and Beethoven!
Warsaw! Rebuilt almost entirely from rubble after World War Two!
Athens! The cradle of Western civilisation and birthplace of democracy!
Budapest! Two cities, Buda and Pest, united across the Danube in eighteen seventy-three!
Lisbon! Europe's westernmost capital, city of seven hills, fado music, and great explorers!
Prague! The City of a Hundred Spires and capital of the Czech Republic!
Brussels! Capital of Belgium and the unofficial capital of the European Union!
Manila! Not the largest city in the Philippines by area, but its historic capital!
Santiago! Capital of the world's longest country, nestled in a valley between the Andes and sea!
Bogotá! One of the world's highest capital cities, over two thousand five hundred metres up!
Nairobi! The only capital city in the world with a national park right on its doorstep!
Rabat! Not Casablanca! Morocco's capital sits on the Atlantic coast!
Naypyidaw! Not Yangon! Myanmar built this brand new capital in complete secrecy and revealed it in two thousand and six!
Sucre! Bolivia has two capitals. Sucre is the constitutional one; La Paz is the seat of government!
Reykjavik! The world's northernmost capital of a sovereign state, powered almost entirely by geothermal energy!
Luxembourg City! The tiny capital of tiny Luxembourg, one of Europe's smallest and wealthiest countries!
Tallinn! One of the best-preserved medieval old towns in Europe, capital of Estonia!
Riga! The largest city in the Baltic states and capital of Latvia!
Vilnius! Lithuania's baroque capital tucked in the green hills of the country's east!
Vaduz! The tiny capital of tiny Liechtenstein, a principality sitting on the Rhine!
Valletta! The smallest capital city in the European Union, built by the Knights of Malta!
Nicosia! The world's last divided capital city, split between Greek and Turkish sides!
Tbilisi! Named after its hot sulphur springs, the ancient capital of Georgia in the Caucasus!
Baku! The oil city on the Caspian Sea and capital of Azerbaijan!
Yerevan! One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities and capital of Armenia!
Ulaanbaatar! The coldest capital city on Earth and home of the descendants of Genghis Khan!
Kathmandu! Gateway to Mount Everest and the ancient capital of Nepal!
Thimphu! One of only two capital cities in the world that has no traffic lights!
Malé! One of the most densely populated cities on Earth and capital of the Maldives!
Suva! The largest city in the South Pacific island nations and capital of Fiji!
Port Moresby! Capital of the land of the unexpected, Papua New Guinea!
Vientiane! One of the world's most laid-back capital cities, on the banks of the Mekong!
Phnom Penh! The Pearl of Asia, capital of Cambodia and home of the Royal Palace!
Montevideo! The southernmost capital city in South America, on the Río de la Plata!
Asunción! One of the oldest cities in South America and capital of Paraguay!
San Marino! The world's oldest republic and the only country whose capital shares its name!
Andorra la Vella! The highest capital city in Europe, over a thousand metres above sea level!
Monaco! The tiny principality's capital is essentially the entire country itself!
Dublin! Fair city on the banks of the River Liffey and capital of Ireland!
